title: lycianthes cyathocalyx
intro: Lycianthes cyathocalyx, commonly known as the purple passion flower, is a plant species within the Solanaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Lycianthes cyathocalyx include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and anxiolytic properties, which can help alleviate pain, muscle spasms, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
